title: Fix Sketchpad Opening for Kit Json in Vscode
description: When opening a kit json it is not opening sketchpad. Make sure that sketchpad has no internal dependency on metabolism etc. The webview build is also running out of memory due to importing everything from compose/js/index.ts which includes node-specific modules.
summary: Fixed VS Code extension not showing sketchpad when opening kit JSON files. Root cause: the webview Vite build was pulling in Node.js-only modules (node:fs, node:path, node:url, @playwright/test, etc.) through the @semio-tech/compose-js and @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad import chains, causing the browser bundle to fail at runtime. Added a stub-node-modules Vite plugin to the webview build config that replaces Node.js built-ins, test frameworks, and benchmark assets with empty module stubs. Also removed debug logging from the extension and fallback HTML.
